title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 50
paragraphs: Such being the situation, the Greek generals — their army cut off from its water and being harassed by the cavalry — assembled to consult about these and other matters, coming to Pausanias on the right wing. For other things troubled them even more than these I have mentioned, since they had no provisions left, and their attendants who had been sent to the Peloponnese for the purpose of getting them had been cut off by the cavalry and could not reach the camp.
